summary: Prenetics Global Limited, a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited Q2 2026 financial results via press release, shareholder letter, and investor presentation. The filing discloses revenue of $46.5 million, up 288% year-over-year, and raises FY2026 revenue guidance to $220-230 million while initiating FY2027 guidance of $400+ million in IM8 revenue. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special-situation transaction. No merger, tender offer, restructuring, or similar event is described. The report is furnished, not filed, and contains no special-situation activities.
